test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

All the guests I have invited to the movie screening __have shown unwilling__ due to their busy schedules.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'have shown unwillingness'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence contains a use of the adjective 'unwilling</strong&
